gizmo.title: Kalendala
gizmo.description: Onetsani zochitika za mu fayilo ya kalendala ngati makhadi a masiku, ndandanda ya nthawi, tebulo kapena mndandanda.

configure.title: Fayilo ya kalendala
configure.description: Kwezani kapena sankhani fayilo ya kalendala ya .ics. Zochitika zake zimawerengedwa mu msakatuli.

configure.title: Onetsani ngati
configure.description: Momwe mungaonetsere zomwe zili mu fayilo.

configure.title: Mutu
configure.description: Umaonetsedwa pamwamba pa zochitika, komanso ngati mutu wa tebulo. Mwachisawawa ndi dzina la kalendala yokha.
